frozen_component_definition: post-RFG residual-incidence connected components with support/owner-labelled canonical component type
frozen_reduction_law: per component type retain multiplicity min(count,2), plus stone-count parity already implicit in support/rank
objective: Freshly falsify or confirm the saturating-2 multiplicity law on 3x5-k3 and 5x3-k3, which were not used in the original SAT2 discovery.
anti_circularity: component extractor unchanged from prior experiment
SAT2 cap fixed before observing holdout results
no value labels in representation construction
interpretation: SAT2 success supports a finite commutative non-group reduction stage before any possible later valuation/XOR composition.
SAT2 failure identifies multiplicity information that remains irreducible and does not by itself falsify a later XOR valuation on further-reduced objects.
